## Problem and change

Describe the trigger, impact and reason for the change. Keep unrelated fixes,
performance changes and formatting in separate commits.

## Validation

List commands and results. For kernel changes, include board, clock, compiler,
optimization level and configuration. Explicitly identify anything not tested.
For performance claims, include before/after measurements and trade-offs.

## Related history

Link relevant issues or verified regression-introducing commits, if known.
